title: BULLETS THROUGH THE RETICLE
why: His 10-29 report: bullets looked high because the whole streak was lifted to gun height. Only the drawn height now blends to the sim line. Watch: bullets now run through the middle of your reticle
now: Local, partner and hostile streaks ease from gun height to ground level over 220 world px. Muzzle flashes, sim flight, hits and impacts keep their positions.
